frozen_identity.question: Will Tesla be the third-largest company in the world by market cap on October 31?
frozen_identity.description:
This market will resolve to the third-largest company in the world by market cap on October 31, 2026, as of market close.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

rule_facts: Frozen rule: Tesla must be the third-largest company worldwide by market capitalization on 2026-10-31 “as of market close”; resolution source is a consensus of credible reporting.
